title: Backup file
description: The JSON downloaded by 'Download backup' and accepted by 'Restore from file'. Keys hold raw localStorage JSON strings so a restore is byte-for-byte.

sessions.description: Count for display only. The app trusts keys, not this number.

keys.description: Only these four are read and written on restore. ol-sync and ol-tombstones are deliberately excluded.

ol-prefs.description: JSON text of the prefs object.

ol-plan.description: JSON text of the plan override object.

ol-drafts.description: JSON text of the drafts object.

ol-sessions.description: JSON text of the LogSession array.
